name: Ayurvedic Treatment of Hyperthermia

sections.ayurvedic_treatment_of_hyperthermia:
We are all familiar with the fact that the normal body temperature ranges from 98.6°F to 100° F. When the body temperature rises above this normal range of temperature, then there exists a problem of hyperthermia. Yes, it is a condition where body temperature may rise over 105 °F. Sometimes, the condition requires medical emergency also, and it occurs when the body fails to regulate its internal temperature. This is a severe form of hyperthermia and is known as heat stroke. Older adults and people with mental problems or other health problems or people at home without air conditioning are at higher risk of the same. At the same time, young people may also develop this problem by staying in extreme temperatures for a long time. The problem can be life threatening and it is better to control it with early diagnosis. Ayurveda is a great and natural way for the same. We will discuss the Ayurvedic concept and its solution, later. 
 What actually happens in Hyperthermia? 
 First of all, we should know what actually happens in this disorder. This occurs when the body absorbs more heat than it actually dissipates. More absorption of heat leads to high temperatures that need medical emergency. So be careful and take it seriously, if you experience high body temperature. One of the common signs of this health problem is Dry skin. Yes, dry skin is the result when the body fails to cool down 
 We have already discussed the general cause of the same. It occurs due to high body temperature. At the same time, it may also occur due to the serious reaction of some drugs to the body. We can say, it is the side effect of drugs. 
 People normally think that they are having fever only. But if the increased body temperature remains unchanged, then you can’t say it’s just a fever. It is hyperthermia. This is the major difference between this problem and fever. In hyperthermia, the body’s temperature set point remains unchanged, while in fever, set point changes.
